question: What procedure applies when an enemy seizes the liṅga or other sacred images?
premises: A liṅga may be seized by an enemy
An image or similar object may be seized
Seizure creates a serious ritual crisis
inference: Seizure of the liṅga or images by an enemy requires special remedial measures
plain_english: If the liṅga or an image and the like has been seized by an enemy.
